relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a Chinese male infant with a TNFAIP3 variant: 'Subsequent whole-exome sequencing identified a heterozygous variant in TNFAIP3: c.1876_1877del (p. Leu626ValfsTer45), leading to the diagnosis of HA20.'
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; rows written with a small Python script (no table transcribed automatically), then every span was checked by script for a verbatim match. In scope: the patient (rule 5 label 'patient') and both parents, who were tested and found not to carry the variant ('Sanger sequencing confirmed that neither parent carried the variant'); labels 'father of patient' and 'mother of patient' from Figure 4 ('the child's father', 'the child's mother'). Parents have no variant rows because neither carries the variant. The two half-brothers ('his two half-brothers had no similar medical history') were neither tested nor affected, so they get no rows. Table 1 lost its bold formatting in conversion ('The bold values provided in Table 1 indicates abnormal results'), so unmentioned out-of-range values (complement C3/C4, haemoglobin 93 g/L, albumin, anti-glycoprotein antibody 247.3R U/mL, Coombs- C3/Coombs-Dott '(++)') were not recorded as features. '(-)' cells (pANCA, cANCA, anti-Smith, SS-A/SS-B, dsDNA-IIF, viral markers) are not defined as negative in the legend, so they were not used to exclude anything. ESR 15 mm/h is at the upper reference limit and was not recorded. Checklist 'genital ulcers' is excluded based on the admission examination 'No abnormalities were detected in the anus or external genitalia.' Diarrhoea was not mapped to 'gastrointestinal ulcers or inflammation' because endoscopy was declined and inflammation is not stated. COVID-19 and enterovirus infections are recorded as features but 'recurrent infections' is left not reported because the authors do not say so. Vital status 'alive' rests on 'he remained under regular follow-up'. Age at diagnosis is not stated (diagnosis came during the readmission) and was not computed. Inconsistencies in the paper: the abstract prints 'p. Leu626ValfsTer45' (with a space) while the text prints 'p.Leu626ValfsTer45'; the Figure 4 legend prints 'NM_001270508.2c.1876_1877del' (no colon) and 'chr6:(138200458-138200459)'; Table 1 gives Creatinine the same value and range as blood urea nitrogen ('3.03 mmol/L (0.8–5.3 mmol/L)') and Red blood cell the white-cell reference range ('4.3–14.2'), probable typesetting errors (not extracted).
